subject: reasoning
question:
The faces of a dice are denoted by the symbols σ, Δ, μ, ε, ω and γ. Two positions of the same dice are shown below. Which face is opposite to the face Δ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/669a635948bfa61b8e3ddec90997a27a73d7e83aea3234a057338d40c607584f.png]
solution:
Logic: If two dice have the same face value in the given image then their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number are known as opposite numbers in dice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d535de7b3f1ce670ad18cd1cd931ede385794aaa036641c12b4e33ba8de617a1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51555f80a1d6e5b9221648ea2fec8cc00749ed9c87be4c4bfcd4ff50668c0a71.png] 

The opposite sides of the dice are given as above.

The remaining face in the given question figure is Δ. 

Therefore, the opposite side to Δ is ε. 

Hence. the correct answer is "Option 4".
